description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, providing REST API endpoints for managing employee language skills and fluencies, including CRUD operations and validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing employee language skills, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting language records, with validation rules and service integrations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee language record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID, returning the data as a model object.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all language records for a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new language record for an employee, after validation and duplication checks.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee language record identified by employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more language records for an employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing employee languages.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing employee language record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for deleting employee language records.
